summary: New York lawyer Roy Cohn helped send the Rosenbergs to the electric chair, ran Joseph McCarthy's Red and Lavender Scare purges in the 1950s, then became a mob lawyer, tax dodger and fixer who mentored Donald Trump before dying of AIDS in 1986.

evidence.note: Cohn's birth in the Bronx to a judge's family
joins the US Attorney's office and prosecutes the Rosenbergs in 1951
long segment on the Lavender Scare and Cohn's interrogations of gay federal workers
Cohn becomes the FBI's press liaison, planting stories for Hoover
Schine draft leads to the Army-McCarthy hearings in 1954
leaves government in 1955, takes over Lionel
systematic tax avoidance through his law firm paying for everything
suspicious 1970s yacht sinking and insurance payout
meets Trump in 1973 and fights the housing discrimination suit with him
fights New York gay rights legislation for the Catholic archdiocese
campaigns for Reagan and uses Roger Stone for dirty tricks in 1980
disbarment and death from AIDS in 1986

notes: No theme for organized crime or legal corruption; Cohn's mob lawyering (Salerno, Trump Tower concrete) is covered under fraud-grift. religious-right-culture-war stands in for anti-gay persecution (Lavender Scare, opposing gay rights laws). reaches_present is true for the recurring Trump/Stone legacy thread up to 2020. Hollywood blacklist and the AIDS ending are short segments.
